title: Two Popes Read It. Both Said Nothing. #Shorts
description:
In 1957 a sealed envelope was locked in a Vatican archive. The woman who wrote it was alive and could have been asked at any time. Nobody asked.

Two popes opened it. Both read it. Both closed it again and said nothing. Everyone else was told only that it existed, so people filled the silence themselves.

Full episode: https://youtu.be/WPOzR9rKv2o

What would you have assumed was inside?

Reconstructions are AI-generated and labelled as such. No likeness of any real person is synthesised.

#Fatima #VaticanArchives #VaticanFiles
